impact: reporting.py:43,149 sizes the block to 4096 raw bytes, hookio.py:168-185 limits the escaped JSON to 4096 and falls back to 900. A 3980-byte block with 5 rows escapes to 4115 bytes; the agent sees 2 rows and no Full report path, while all principle explanations are marked shown. advise() (hookio.py:239-242) sends the message twice, so PostToolUse breaks near 2 KB. Fix: measure with hookio.sends_whole in compact_block, or clip the reason to fit instead of dropping to 900.
title: Block messages over the escaped 4 KB limit drop to 900 bytes and lose the report path
